device.description: 14-bit 2.5 MSPS single-ended-input SAR ADC with SPI-compatible serial interface
device.note: ads7056.pdf (SBAS769) p.3 pin configuration and functions, p.4 recommended operating conditions, p.6 timing requirements and switching characteristics (Figures 1-2), p.18 transfer characteristics (Table 1), p.20 CNV state / serial interface (Figure 40), p.21-22 offset calibration (OFFCAL state)

pages: p.3 (pins), p.4 (ROC), p.6 (timing, Figures 1-2), p.18 (transfer characteristics), p.20 (Figure 40 serial interface), p.21-22 (offset calibration)
notModeled: analog input (single-ended input); conversion is clocked by SCLK (18 SCLK falling edges, not timed: the result is the 0 V code at once)
pipelined output: each frame shifts out the previous conversion (the first frame after power-up is all zeros, which the 0 V code already is); with a constant code this is not observable
fewer than 18 SCLK falling edges in a frame gives an invalid result in the next frame
offset calibration (OFFCAL state: 24 SCLKs in the first frame after power-up, 64 SCLKs in a frame during normal operation; SDO outputs 0s)
throughput, acquisition time and SCLK frequency limits
tFloat: the datasheet gives only a 5.5 ns minimum for tdz_CSDO
